note: Provisional census of reuse/alias/candidate for the Command Suite keyboard-first surface. Exact IDs adjudicated by Commands owner; nothing canonical assigned here.

preserve_or_reuse.use_in_concept: Providers roster detail: account selection popup (PMManagers2.popupMenu).
Providers detail: routing/fallback row action.
Providers usage table refresh (ObservableWork, cached values visible during refresh).
Usage table export action (receipt).
Shell Settings rail item and Close Settings return target.
Ctrl+K / '/' focuses the universal search from any pane.
Enter on a highlighted dropdown row routes by rid.
Arrow-key drill between Index, Pages, and Detail panes.
Enter on a command-index row opens the domain pane.
Enter on a page row opens the page pane.
Deep-link scroll+focus+pm2-locate on the exact row.
Enter on a manager row opens #/mgr/<familyId>.
Every row control change (PMState2.setSetting).
Row Details reset-to-default and editor Reset.
Copy flow preview step (PMCopy2.preview).
Copy flow confirm step (restore point, atomic apply, verify).
Lifecycle rollback action over restore points.
Models table refresh with last-known values offline.
Reconnect-required scenario row action.
Update ask-first flow in provider install section.
Verification-failed rolled-back receipt path.

retire_or_alias.reason: Old chip/bloom architecture; Command Suite has no bloom surface. Preserve compatibility alias only if needed; concept never renders it.

candidates.rationale: Ctrl+K command palette overlay listing index destinations, managers, and actions; distinct from search.focus (overlay vs inline field).
Enter executes the highlighted palette entry via canonical dest object (rid or route), never by visual index.
Move focus one pane right (Index→Pages→Detail), keyboard-first drill-down.
Move focus one pane left; at Index pane acts as Back one Settings level.
Escape order: popup → palette/drawer → one level out → stop at Home.
Exact setting editor beside context: explicit Save applies staged value via cmd.settings.value.set with receipt.
candidates.idempotency: revision-checked; stale editor shows changed-elsewhere notice

candidates.rationale: Discard staged editor value; no state mutation.

collision_notes: cmd.settings.palette.open must not shadow a global app palette; propose Settings-scoped activation only while Settings surface is focused.
cmd.settings.editor.save is a projection of cmd.settings.value.set with staged payload; if Commands owner rejects, reuse value.set directly and drop the candidate.
